definition.objective: Maximize indicated thermal efficiency among candidates satisfying the existing motor feasibility constraints, including >=40 W.
definition.mass_policy: Candidate-specific uniform 100 kPa filling at theta=0 using actual cylinder and exchanger volumes.
definition.valve_policy: Each exchanger outlet-valve CdA scales linearly with tube count relative to retained K2 hardware.
definition.search_strategy: Four explicit controls, then alternating broad 9D Sobol proposals and incumbent-centered Sobol proposals. Local radius decreases 0.12 -> 0.06 -> 0.03 in normalized coordinates.
definition.fan_power_policy: Reported by exchanger metadata but excluded from the efficiency objective under the current project decision.
